Project Overview: TerraCycle

Empowering Farmers Worldwide with NASA Earth Observations and AI-Driven Crop Rotation

1. Background & The Problem

Farmers around the globe face escalating challenges from shifting temperatures, erratic rainfall patterns, prolonged water shortages, extreme weather events, and declining soil health. Traditional farming calendars and monocropping (planting the exact same crop season after season) are no longer viable under modern climate pressures. While crop rotation is a proven method to protect fields, conserve water, and restore soil fertility, choosing the right rotation sequence is complex, highly localized, and difficult to calculate without agronomic expertise.

2. Solution Summary

TerraCycle is a global, AI-powered decision-support tool designed to bridge the gap between complex space-based science and daily farm management. By combining NASA Earth observations, global soil databases, FAO crop characteristics, and farmer-specific priorities, TerraCycle generates tailored, multi-season crop rotation plans in under 30 seconds. It requires no expensive hardware or ground sensors, making it accessible to farmers anywhere in the world using just a smartphone or low-bandwidth connection.

3. Core Features & User Workflow

  • 3-Tap Simple Interface:
    1. Location: The farmer drops a GPS pin (or selects a region) to instantly pull local climate and soil baselines.
    2. Crop Selection: The farmer selects their current and planned crops from a visual icon grid (e.g., corn, wheat, rice, soybeans, legumes).
    3. Priority Setting: The farmer specifies their primary goal—such as $\text{💧 Saving Water}$, $\text{🌱 Restoring Soil Health}$, $\text{💰 Maximizing Yield}$, or $\text{🔥 Surviving Extreme Heat}$.
  • Automated Data Integration: Behind the scenes, the app queries free public datasets—including NASA POWER (for temperature, radiation, and rainfall trends), NASA SMAP (for soil moisture and drought stress), and ISRIC SoilGrids (for soil texture, pH, and organic carbon).
  • The Decision-Support Engine: An AI-backed rules engine cross-references local environmental conditions with a built-in FAO Crop Characteristics Knowledge Base to match heavy feeder crops with nitrogen-fixing or drought-hardy rotation partners.
  • Actionable Output Dashboard: Generates a 3-season rotation timeline complete with impact metrics (e.g., water savings percentage, soil nitrogen boost) and a plain-language explanation of why the rotation protects their harvest.

4. Dataset Foundation

TerraCycle is built on robust open-access data sources categorized into four operational pillars:

  • Space & Satellite Observations: SMAP (soil moisture), GPM/IMERG (precipitation), Landsat & MODIS (vegetation indices/NDVI), ECOSTRESS (land surface temperature and evapotranspiration), and SRTM (elevation and slope).
  • Soil & Land Cover Data: ISRIC SoilGrids, USDA Web Soil Survey, and Cropland Data Layer (CDL).
  • Climate & Agroclimatology: NASA POWER agroclimatological normals, PRISM, and FAO GAEZ.
  • Agricultural Context: USDA Ag Data Commons and NASS QuickStats for agronomic baselines.

5. Impact & Vision

TerraCycle transforms raw satellite data into practical, field-level wisdom. By helping farmers diversify their fields sustainably, the tool enhances long-term climate resilience, reduces the need for synthetic fertilizers, conserves vital water resources, and secures food production worldwide.
